title: M5GFX #443 review: default touch I2C clock 1 MHz -> 400 kHz

firmware.build: ESP-IDF v6.1, target esp32s3, 8MB flash + 8MB octal PSRAM, examples/Test/build_test with a shared harness main.cpp

execution.environment: macOS arm64; local Device Service (m5stack-device-service v1) profile stopwatch (qemu-esp32s3/m5stopwatch, CO5300 466x466, simulated); no physical hardware

checks.detail: OPEN, not draft, author ainyan03, English, 0 comments / 0 reviews before this review, mergeable
CST3530/CST816S/CST226/CST9217, CHSC6540, GT911, ST7123 use the default; FT5x06 sets 400 kHz itself; CoreS3 sets 400 kHz in Touch_M5StackCoreS3
apply_i2c_touch_desc always assigns cfg.freq = desc.freq; desc default is already 400000; runtime board_touch freq=400000 in both builds
soft_i2c.inl:123 gives half_us=0 at >=500 kHz and 2 us at 400 kHz; no built-in M5GFX board uses a software I2C port for touch
CHSC6x/NS2009/TT21xxx/GSLx680/XPT2046/RA8875/STMPE610 are not in M5GFX; the list belongs to LovyanGFX #1019. Documentation-only, no code impact
default_config_freq=400000, driver_default_freq=400000, touch_init=1, raw n=1 x=120 y=120, frame sha256 d2a742c8...1a8a2
default_config_freq=1000000, driver_default_freq=1000000, touch_init=1, raw n=1 x=120 y=120, same frame sha256
bash test/board_detect/run.sh -> 34/34 C++ test programs passed
QEMU I2C model decodes commands/FIFO without SCL period; configured frequency was read back, not measured

limits: Only CST816S/CST820 exercised; GT911, CHSC6540, CST9217, ST7123 did not run
Actual 400 kHz SCL timing not measured; no scope/logic-analyser data
Single power-on run and single tap per build; no soak, warm reset or repeated touch
